BiblicalUsage: Abarim is the range of mountains east of the Jordan, across from Jericho — the 'mount Abarim' where God tells Moses, 'Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.' Israel camps 'in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo', and Moses is told again to climb and view the land he will not enter.
TheologicalSignificance: Moses sees the promise from Abarim and dies without setting foot in it, and that has always moved me. I believe God can show us the land and still say 'not yet' or 'not you' — and faith is trusting Him from the mountaintop, even when the crossing belongs to someone else.
